title: Device and method for transmitting signal in wireless communication system

pse.problem: Limitation in secure data transmission during federated learning in a wireless communication system
pse.solution_function: The terminal configures and transmits a resource for federated learning, generates a pseudo-random sequence based on differential privacy-related information received from the base station, and transmits data to the base station using this sequence.
pse.solution_structure: Terminal (hardware), Base Station (hardware), federated learning configuration information (software), differential privacy level (software), band matrix (data structure)
pse.solution_implementation: The terminal receives federated learning-related configuration information, configures a resource based on this information, transmits its differential privacy level to the base station, generates a pseudo random sequence using differential privacy-related information from the base station, and sends data to the base station using the configured resource and the generated pseudo random sequence.
pse.effect: Improved privacy security in wireless communication system based on federated learning
